title: Login to HylooSec
description: Use your User ID and password to securely access your HylooSec account.

blocks.text: The Login page allows existing HylooSec users to securely access their account using the User ID generated during registration and the password created while creating the account.

blocks.title: Before You Login
blocks.text: Keep your User ID, password and your chat security key or encrypted key file ready before logging in.

fields.name: User ID
fields.description: Enter the User ID provided after successful account creation.

fields.name: Password
fields.description: Enter the password created during account registration.

fields.name: Terms & Conditions
fields.description: Read and accept the Terms & Conditions before logging in.

items.title: Click Login
items.description: Press the Login button to continue.

blocks.text: After your User ID and password are successfully verified, HylooSec asks you to verify your chat security.

items.title: If You Selected an Encrypted Key File
items.description: Upload the same encrypted key file that was generated or selected during account creation.

items.title: If You Selected a Security Key
items.description: Enter the security key exactly as it was created during registration.

items.title: Complete Verification
items.description: After successful verification, your protected chats become accessible.

blocks.title: Important
blocks.text: Without the correct encrypted key file or security key, protected chats cannot be accessed.
After successful login and chat security verification, HylooSec keeps your account logged in for up to 7 days on the current device.

blocks.title: Session Expiry
blocks.text: After 7 days, you will be required to log in again and complete chat security verification.

blocks.title: Available Actions
items: Forgot Password - Recover access to your account by verifying your identity.
Create Account - Register a new HylooSec account.
Learn More - Read about HylooSec and its features.

items.solution: Enter only the numeric User ID provided during registration.
Verify that the password is entered correctly.
Select the checkbox before clicking Login.
Upload the same encrypted key file associated with your account.
Enter the exact security key that was created during registration.
Log in again using your User ID, password and chat security method.

items: Never share your encrypted key file.
Always log in using the official HylooSec website.
Store your encrypted key file in a secure location.
Log out from public or shared devices.

popup.title: Login Help
content: Complete chat security verification using your encrypted key file or security key.
Your login session remains active for up to 7 days.
